DeLoia 1998 is direct human counter-evidence to this edge and belongs on it as a CONTRADICTION, not as support: the resulting assertion must carry direction_supported=contradicted and curation_status=disputed. With CT-1 against the MUC1 cytoplasmic tail, MUC1 core protein is maintained in the human LUMINAL epithelium through the mid-luteal receptive phase; only the HMFG-1 ectodomain epitope is lost, and it is restored by keratanase or neuraminidase predigestion. The edge as encoded reads abundance; the human data say glycosylation. Descriptive immunohistochemistry, mid-luteal n=5, no perturbation and no adhesion assay, so it disputes the edge without licensing a replacement sign. Bears on GAP-004.

Horne 2006 is the second, independent contradiction of this edge and must likewise carry direction_supported=contradicted and curation_status=disputed. In HEC1A, HEC1B, Ishikawa and RL95-2, progesterone UP-regulates MUC1 at protein and MUC1-promoter-reporter level, i.e. the opposite sign to the encoded inhibition, while oestrogen and interleukin-1-beta are both explicit nulls. Carcinoma lines, unpolarised, no primary epithelium and no adhesion or embryo endpoint, so it cannot license the reverse edge either.
